levels.unknown: not yet verified; never treat absence as proof of nonexistence
levels.observed: directly observed in identified source media or captured protocol data
levels.reproduced: behavior/data extraction reproduced with project tooling
levels.matched: reconstructed output matches the identified original at the declared comparison level

rules: Do not infer a regional/revision identity from filename alone.
Do not copy later-generation values backward into Generation III data.
Keep official original behavior separate from project redesigns.
Record unused, dummy, inaccessible, and debug data instead of deleting it from scope.
Commercial source media remains outside GitHub; only derived metadata and reconstructed/project-created files are committed.
